title: An astrocyte-microglia MFG-E8 axis promotes synapse engulfment in early amyloid pathology
title_zh: 星胶质-微胶质 MFG-E8 轴在早期淀粉样病理中促进突吞噬
abstract: Region-specific synapse loss is an early hallmark of Alzheimer's disease, yet the upstream signals that render synapses vulnerable remain unclear. In a mouse model of amyloidosis, we identify an early astrocyte state that emerges in vulnerable brain regions before widespread plaque deposition and overt gliosis. These astrocytes exhibit bulbous-looking perisynaptic processes enriched in p62 and glycogen, impaired autophagic flux and calcium signaling, and diminished astrocyte-synapse coverage. Rather than exhibiting increased synapse engulfment, bulbous astrocytes show elevated milk fat globule-epidermal growth factor 8 (MFG-E8) and are associated with increased local microglial synapse engulfment. Astrocyte-specific gain- and loss-of-function experiments demonstrate that astrocyte-derived MFG-E8 is required for microglial synapse engulfment and acts through microglial β3 integrin signaling. Astrocytic Mfge8 deletion reduces microglial engulfment and synapse loss across amyloidosis models and is associated with reduced amyloid pathology, gliosis, and cognitive impairment. Together, these findings define an astrocyte-microglia MFG-E8 signaling axis that contributes to region-specific synaptic vulnerability during early amyloid pathology.
abstract_zh: 阿尔茨海默病早期特征是特定突触的丢失，但使突触易受损的上游信号仍不清楚。在淀粉样病理小鼠模型中，我们在广泛斑块形成和明显胶质细胞反应之前，在脆弱脑区出现了一种早期星胶质状态。这些星胶质表现为突触周围过程膨大，富含p62和糖原，自噬流动受损以及钙信号受损，且与突触的星胶质覆盖减少相关。与其表现出突触吞噬增加相反，膨大的星胶质表现为MFG-E8（milk fat globule-epidermal growth factor 8，乳脂球-上皮生长因子8）水平升高，并与局部微胶质突触吞噬增加相关。星胶质特异性增减功能实验表明，星源性MFG-E8对微胶质突触吞噬是必需的，并通过微胶质β3整合素信号通路发挥作用。星胶质Mfge8敲除可减少淀粉样病理模型中的微胶质吞噬和突触丢失，并与淀粉样病理、胶质细胞反应和认知障碍减少相关。这些发现共同定义了一种星胶质-微胶质MFG-E8信号轴，该轴在早期淀粉样病理中导致特定脑区的突触脆弱性。
